items.title: Sweet Williams Interview
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] ... Ford. Just Ford. Did Clayton? [INTERVIEWEE] I know Clayton. Trumpet player.

ctx.x: And they were very glad to have... You know, he had whiskey. Thirty-five years old, and he said, me and when I go down there, me and him drank a little bit. He drank it in sugar, he drank a little bit. He drank it in sugar, he drank it in his body. He drank it in his body. He drank it in his body. I got to drink this. And he was sick. This is the old, this is the late picture of this place. When the man had broke. This is really him when he was young. Yeah.

I got a list of the Barrow House piano players in New Orleans. Let me pick some out. Did you ever hear the name Papa Lord God? I have heard of, but I don't know. I couldn't tell you nothing about it. Regging Willie Welf. No, I don't know. Ford. Just Ford. Did Clayton?
